༄༅/ /tshe dpag med gong khug ma gnyis kyi cho ga bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// tshe dpag med gong khug ma gnyis kyi cho ga bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ rje btsun zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// phul byung 'dod dgu'i ya mtshan bye ba brgyas// 'chi med gnas la mngon 'dod gsar pa yis// rings par gyur rnams skal ba bzang mdzad pa// grub pa'i rgyal mo brgyud par bcas la 'dud// rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal bzhad pa rdo rje'i phyag bzhes las byung ba/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar 'dod pas/ thog mar/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ rdul tshon gyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ de'i steng du mañji'i khar/ bum pa bzang po dam tshig gi rdzas btab pa'i chus bkang*/ mgul chings dmar pos byas shing*/ 'bras bu can gyi shing gi yal ga khri'us kha brgyan pa/ g.yas su ka pā la bdud rtsis bkang ba dang*/ g.yon du bum pa dang dung chos dri bzang po'i chus gtams pa/ mtha' mar mchod pa'i rdzas dang gtor ma phyag bzhes bzhin bshams nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis tshe dpag med du bltas pa'i snying ga'i hrīḥyig gi 'od kyi lcags kyus bla ma dang tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ ces pas phyag byas/ oṃ a pa ri mi tā yur+dz+nyā na sa pa ri wā ra/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta sbyar bas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes yan lag bdun pa lan gsum byas/ lha dang bla ma rang nyid la bstim mo// de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi la gnas par byas nas/ oṃ swa bhā was chos thams cad stong pa nyid du byas pa'i dbyings su/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de rnams kyi dbus dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la hrīḥyig dmar po 'od 'bar ba/

shar lhor a/ lho nub tu pa/ nub byang du sa/ byang shar du a rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa/ shar du rdo rje/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du 'phrin las tshe dpag med/ thams cad sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'chi ba med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i baiḍūr+ya mthon mthing gi lhung bzed bsnams pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ lta bas chog mi shes pa'i mtshan dpes brjid pa/ shar lhor lcags kyu ma dkar mo phyag gnyis lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu zhags pa ma ser mo phyag gnyis zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du lcags sgrog ma dmar mo phyag gnyis lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dril bu ma ljang kha phyag gnyis dril bu 'dzin pa/ de thams cad kyang brgyad gnyis lon pa'i lang tshos sgeg cing*/ blta bas mi ngoms pa tsam du mdzes pas 'gying ba skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūṃ/ lte bar trāṃ/ gsang bar a/ sa bon lnga'i 'od zer gyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ slar yang sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa lnga spyan drangs/ bdag bskyed kyi lha la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma so so'i spyi bor brtan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i rang bzhin gyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan lngas ral pa'i cod pan brgyan par gyur*/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer spros pa mchod rdzas rnams la phog pas/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med pa'i char gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams 'gengs pa'i sprin gyi phung po chen por gyur/

oṃ a pa ri mi tā yur+dz+nyā na sa pa ri wā ri ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ ru pa/ shap+ta gan+dhe/ rā sa spar+she/ ste 'dod yon lnga phul/ oṃḥ.āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ badz+ra pañca a mṛ ta sa bdud rtsi myang*/ ma lus 'gro rnams bdud bzhi dgra thabs las// rnam rgyal 'chi med go 'phang la 'god phyir// sna tshogs snying rje'i 'khor los bsgyur mdzad pa'i// rigs lnga tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'chi med bdud rtsi bcud rnams ma lus pa// dgug gzhug bcing mnyes ro mnyam las mdzad phyir// yid 'phrog sgeg mo'i ngang tshul la gnas pa'i// lcags kyu ma sogs lha tshogs bzhi la bstod// nang gi rnal 'byor ro// mdun bskyed ni/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ ka pā la'i bdud rtsi / oṃ swa bhā was chos thams cad stong pa nyid du byas pa'i dbyings su/ nas/ bstod pa'i bar/ dbang gi tshe mdun bskyed kyi lha la zhes sbyar ba tsam ma gtogs gong du bshad pa ji lta ba bya'o// bum pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ dung chos kyi dri chu la hrīḥbazlas pa gzungs thag rdo rje dang bcas pa bum pa'i steng du bzhag oṃ swa bhā was chos thams cad stong pa nyid du byas pa'i dbyings su/ paṃ las pad+ma'i lte bar/ baṃ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan cing*/ gos bzang po'i mgul chings can/ nang rdzas ma tshang ba med pa/ ye shes kyi rang bzhin can gyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ nas/ dbang bskur ba'i tshe bum bskyed kyi lha la zhes sbyar te ji skad bshad pa'i bstod pa'i bar du'o// de nas bzlas pa ni/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hrīḥyig de'i mthar/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wān+tā ye swā hā 'am/ yang na/ ye'i zhabs su ā yu de wa re ka pa ra sha ni hūm̐ phaṭa swā hās bskor ba/ de las 'od 'phros/

lha mo bzhi la phog de rnams kyi sprul pas 'jig rten thams cad gang bar byas te/ rang gi tshe brkus shing phrogs pa yar zhing 'khyar ba dang*/ sa chu me rlung la brten nas tshe bsring bar nus pa'i bcud dang*/ sems can gyi tshe dang bsod nams/ tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad kyi byin rlabs thams cad lcags kyu mas bkug zhags pa mas bcings/ lcags sgrog mas bsdams/ dril bu mas phab nas bum pa'i tshe chu dang*/ ka pā la'i bdud rtsi dang dbyer med du 'dres par bsam la brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa ci rigs par bzlas/ dung chos kyi chu nang du blugs/ bum nang gi lha tshogs 'chi med kyi tshe chur zhu bar bsam/ de nas las bum du/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭ kyis rta mgrin dmar po khro zhing gtum pa'i rtsa zhal dang*/ spyi bor rta mgo ljang nag sgeg cing dpa' ba'i sku/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas dbyug tho nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ khro bo'i stang stabs kyis ye shes kyi me'i phung po'i dbus na pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i thugs kar nyin byed la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad kyi nus mthu thams cad bsdus nas slar de nyid la thim par mos pas snying po bzlas/ mthar nad gdon thams cad 'joms pa'i chur zhu bar bsam mo/ de nas gtor ma sbyangs te/ oṃ las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ āḥlas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi/ hūm̐ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med pa'i rgya mtshor bsams nas/ a pa ri mi tā a yur+dz+nyā na sa pa ri wā ri i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi lan bdun nam lngas phul la/ 'chi ba med pa'i tshe'i mchog blang ngo*// dbang bskur ba ni/ khrus byas/ bgegs bskrad/ bsrung 'khor bsgoms te maṇ+ḍal phul la/

sdom pa 'dzin pa'i don du/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can gyis gsol ba lan gsum btab/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa'i dbus na rnam par brjid pa'i bla ma tshe dpag tu med pa'i spyan sngar/ lhag bsam thun mong ma yin pas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi zhes lan gsum gyis sdom pa gzung*/ de nas/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// byin rlabs 'chi med tshe dbang bzhi// de ring bdag la stsal du gsol// de nas slob ma la las bum gyi chus bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ tshe dpag tu med par bskyed/ bla ma la mos gus dungs dungs zhig byas pas/ thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i gtso bo la phog de'i phyag gi lhung bzed kyi bdud rtsi zhu zhing khol cher lud pas/ slob ma'i spyi bor dbang bskur bar mdzad pa dang lhan cig bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ yig las kyang 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi rgyun 'bab bzhin pa/ slob ma'i spyi bor thim par mos te/ dngos su slob dpon gyis tshe'i bum pa thogs nas spyi bor/ sangs rgyas kun gyi skur gyur pa// mgon po tshe dpag med pa yis// lus la mngon par dbang bskur bas// tshe srog rgyas shing brtan gyur cig oṃ bud+dha ā yur+dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ zhes dbang bskur zhing tshe chu blug pas/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo 'chi ba med pa'i ye shes kyi chus gang nyon mongs pa gti mug dang de'i dbang gis bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad dag me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku'i dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam mo// yang*/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od pad+ma tshe dpag med la phog de'i= slob ma'i mgrin par= bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥyig las kyang= mgrin par= sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gyur pa/ pad+ma tshe= ngag la= tshe srog= oṃ pad+ma= ṣiñca āḥ dbang bskur/

mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo= nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang*/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dang*/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i gsung gi= yang*/ bla ma'i= rdo rje tshe/ snying gar/ hūm̐ yig las kyang*/ snying gar/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs gyur pa/ rdo rje tshe= yid la= tshe= oṃ badz+ra/ nas hūm̐ gis dbang*/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo= nyon mongs pa zhe sdang= chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes= tshe dpag tu med pa'i thugs kyi= yang bla= rin chen tshe= lte bar= traṃ las kyang= lte bar= sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan mchog /rin chen tshe= yon tan gnas su dbang= tshe= oṃ rat+na/ nas/ trāṃ gis dbang*/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo= nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dang= mnyam nyid ye shes= tshe dpag tu med pa'i yon tan gyi= yang bla= 'phrin las tshe= gsang bar= a las kyang= gsang ba/ sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las mchog /'phrin las tshe= phrin las gnas su dbang= tshe srog= oṃ karma nas/ a dbang*/ gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo= nyon mongs pa phrag dog= bya ba grub pa'i ye shes= tshe dpag tu med pa'i 'phrin las kyi dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam mo// de ltar 'chi ba med pa'i ye shes kyi chus lus thams cad gang*/ phung sogs kyi dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o// bum dbang ngo*// ka pā la'i bdud rtsi slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dang*/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sarba saṃ skā ra sogs spyi sngags brjod cing*/ ka pā la'i lha tshogs 'chi ba med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi byang sems dkar dmar gyi rnam par zhu ba spyi bo nas rdo rje nor bu'i sna rtse'i bar du babs pas/ nyi zla'i rgyu ba 'gags/ dbu ma'i stobs rgyas pas slar gyen du gshegs te/ rtsa 'khor lo lnga 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi byang chub kyi sems kyis brtan par gang*/

'khor lo so so'i lte bar rigs lnga'i sa bon gyi yi ge rnams su gyur pa/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sogs pa'i rkyen ngan dang bar chad gang gis kyang mi shigs pa'i srog gi gzungs su brtan par gnas par bsam/ slob dpon gyis oṃ āḥsogs brjod cing rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas reg ste/ gnas so sor dri'i thig le bya/ des lus thams cad 'chi med kyi bdud rtsis gang*/ las rlung gi rgyu ba sbyangs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ rtsa rlung bsgom pa la dbang*/ gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// gsang dbang ngo*// slob ma bla ma'i mos gus la gnas pas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis lha mo bzhi bskul bas sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje 'chi ba med pa tshe'i gzungs su gnas pa thams cad/ lha mo lcags kyu mas slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la bkug zhags pa mas lhan cig tu bcings/ lcags sgrog mas gnyis su med par bsdams/ dril bu mas ro mnyam pa'i tshul gyis dbang du byas par dmigs te/ rol mo'i sgra drag po dang*/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lcags kyu'i phyag rgya g.yab cing*/ oṃ aṃ ku sha sa ma ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ā yur+dz+nya na hrīḥbh+rūṃ/ zhes drag tu brjod/ zhags pa la sogs pa'i phyag rgya lhag ma rnams kyis mnan/ des lus 'chi ba med pa sku rdo rje/ ngag 'chi ba med pa gsung rdo rje/ yid 'chi ba med pa thugs rdo rjer gyur pa yin no zhes brjod de/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod pas bskal pa'i bar du mi 'gyur bar brtan pa dang*/ mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog/ ces sogs kyi shis pa brjod do// oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes pas rab tu gnas par bya/ slob dpon gyis spyi sngags gnyis lan bdun brjod pa'i mthar/

slob ma rjes zlos byed du bcug ste/ bcom ldan 'di la dang*/ bcom ldan bdag gis sa ོgas kyis bzlas lung yang sbyin no// des thig le'i 'dzag pa'i dri ma sbyangs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o// dbang gsum pa'o// de nas/ slob mas mi phyed pa'i dad pas gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams gnas lnga dang*/ lus la thim/ lha mtshan slob ma'i spyi bor bkod/ phung khams skye mched kyi chos thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid du dbugs dbyung zhing*/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du rgyas btab pas/ 'jig rten gsum gyis rgyal bar ma nus pa'i 'chi bdag la sogs pa'i bdud bzhi'i dgra las rgyal ba'i tshe'i rig 'dzin thob par bsam mo// des lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// dbang bzhi pa'o// bdag 'jug gi tshe/ bla ma'i bya ba gtso bos mdzad par bsam/ lha lnga'i tshe/ pad 'dab bzhi dang*/ rigs lnga bskyed pa las khyad chos lhag pa gzhan med cing*/ dbang gsum pa'i tshe/ lha mo bzhi thugs ka nas spro ba las gzhan mtshungs pa nyid do// 'di la rigs lnga'i dbang re'i mthar/

dbus kyi phyogs nas bkra shis don gyi lha// rnam par snang mdzad bkra shis don gyi lha// rnam par snang mdzad bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /nub kyi phyogs nas bkra shis don gyi lha// snang ba mtha' yas bkra shis don gyi lha// snang ba mtha' yas bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /shar gyi phyogs nas bkra shis don gyi lha/ rdo rje sems dpa' bkra shis don gyi lha// rdo rje sems dpa' bkra shis gang lags pa*// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /lho yi phyogs nas bkra shis don gyi lha/ rin chen 'byung ldan bkra shis don gyi lha// rin chen 'byung ldan bkra shis gang lags pa*/ bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog byang gi phyogs nas bkra shis don gyi lha/ don yod grub pa bkra shis don gyi lha/ don yod grub pa bkra shis gang lags pa*// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/ zhes sogs shis brjod byed pa spros pa la dga' na'o// rje btsun man ngag rin chen 'phreng ba 'di// tshig gi srad bu ring por 'thor mthong nas// 'tsham pa'i pad+ma'i skud pa 'dir brgyus pas// don gnyer mgul ba skal bzang nyid gyur cig /rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i gong khug tu sbas pa tshe dpag med lha dgu dang lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gsung bzhin du bkod pa'o// ༈ //sems can re re'i don du'ang mdzad pa'i phul// nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam pa'i tshul de yis// kun la phan pa bsgrub pa'i thugs rje can// bzhad pa rdo rje yab yum la 'dud do// rje btsun mi la'i zhal snga nas ji ltar gsungs pa ltar gyi bkra shis tshe ring ma mched lnga'i rjes gnang sbyin par 'dod pas/ gong du bshad pa'i tshe dpag med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi mdun nam/ g.yon du rdul tshon gyi pad+ma 'dab bzhi'am/ yang na/ grwa chings/

dar ras dkar po dri ma med pa gang rung gi khar mtshal cog la ma'i g.yung drung lnga tshoms su bris/ rin po che'i snod gtsang mar/ 'bru dkar po'i phye/ ra dkar mo dang*/ ba dmar mo'i 'o mas sbrus pa la 'brang rgyas so so'i ri dang 'dra ba'i rtse mo rin po che 'bar bas brgyan pa la/ mda' rgod sgro mar/ dar me long*/ mu tig sor gdub/ g.yu chung*/ bdud rtsi lnga dang sin+dhu ra/ ne'u le'i rlid bu'am/ dar gyi khung du bcug pa dang*/ lha mo so so'i tsak+ka li gdags pa btsugs te/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir go rim bzhin bzhag g.yas su thod pa bzang po'am/ rin po che'i bum pa la sogs pa bdud rtsi lnga'i sman phabs can gyi tshe chang gis gang ba mar gyi ze sgro can dang*/ g.yon du tshe zan bum pa'i dbyibs can/ spod zan gyi tshe ril brums su bcer ba/ gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ dngul dkar gyi me long*/ zas sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i rin po che'i gzhong pa/ rin po che'i sgrom bu rtsa dur ba'i chun po rnams phyogs su bkod/ dar zab rin po che'i 'phreng ba la sogs pa'i spyan gzigs me tog sih+la la sogs pa mchod pa'i bye brag 'byor tshad dang*/ rdor dril/ cang te'u/ ka pā la chang gis bkang ba la sogs pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas dang*/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad dang*/ yi dam/ ḍā ki zhing skyong*/ gzhi bdag gi gtor ma bshams zhing bkod pas mdzes par bya'o// de nas nang gi rnal 'byor ni bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig gi 'od kyis bcom ldan 'das ma'i spyi bor/ rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje/ de'i spyi bor mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa mtho brtsegs su bzhugs pa la bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

nas/ shap+ta'i bar chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyis bdun rnam dag bya/ mthar rang la bstim/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wa brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum pa'i dbus su pad+ma'i lte bar/ ro ser po'i snying gar hrīḥdamar po yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rje btsun lhan cig skyes ma bde ba'i nyams kyis rgyas pa'i lang tsho can/ zhal gcig mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum ma phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ thod skam lnga'i cod pan dang*/ mgo bo rlon pa'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ he ru ka'i rang bzhin gyi khaṭ+wāṃ ga gru mo g.yon pas 'khyud pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na rol pa'i spyi bor oṃ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya pheṃ gyi sgra dang bcas pas ye shes sems dpa' dbang gi lha tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang bsres/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tas byang chub sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ dri ma dag slar spyi bor brtan pas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ snying ga'i sa bon gyis spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo nam mkha' gang bas mchod par mos te/ gong bzhin mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gros bstod/ nang mchod sbyangs / oṃ yig gis thod pa'i snod rgya che ba/ āḥyig gis dam tshig gi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho/ hūm̐ yig gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ ha hoḥhrīḥro mnyam du byas/ oṃ badz+ra pañca a mṛ ta khā his myang bar bya'o// lte bar hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rtsa sngags/ oṃ badz+ra bā rā hi hūṃ phaṭa/

ces pa snying po/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes pas nye snying rnams bzlas par bya'o// de nas gtor ma bsang sbyangs nas/ nang mchod bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ pheṃ gyi sgras rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ye shes kyi ḍā ki lnga/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs lhar dag pa dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba gtod de/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra a ra li zhes sogs kyi 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ oṃ kha khas 'jig rten pa la phul/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang gi sh+lo ka gcig gis smon la ma gdab bo// mdun bskyed ni/ gtor ma lnga bsangs sbyangs/ lha mo lnga bskyed nas bstod pa'i bar yid kyi 'dod 'jor bshad bzhin byas/ rang gi lte ba'i hrīḥyig gi 'od kyis bkra shis tshe ring ma dpon g.yog lnga bkug ste/ rang la bskor ba byed cing gus mdud dang bcas pas so so'i las bsgrub par bsam la/ oṃ ma ma ru ru tsit+ta dhā ra me dzu tī oṃ bh+yo dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra bhi kyai mu ta hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ya tra sing sing hūṃ bh+yo dzaḥ oṃ a bī ra nī hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ oṃ sa raṃ ting ting kha ti dz+nyā na hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ zhes pa sman btsun lnga'i dam tshig gnad la bor ba'i srog sngags rnams kyang ci rigs par bzlas pas bdag gi dbang du gyur pas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshe bsring bsod nams bskyed/ dpal dang 'byor pa spel bar nus pa'i bdud rtsi'i bcud ma lus pa bsdus/ tshe bum skad cig gis rin po che'i bum par gyur pa dang*/ ka pā la'i nang du blugs pas zhu zhing khol te chil li li lud par bsgoms/ mdun bskyed do// rjes su gnang ba bya ba la/ tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i de ma thag tu/ slob dpon rje btsun lhan cig skyes mar bsgoms la/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te/ phun tshogs dngos grub ma lus pa// yid bzhin myur du bsgrub pa'i phyir// bdag la bkra shis tshe ring ma// mched lnga'i rjes gnang stsal du gsol//

zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ swa bhā was slob ma sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung dmar po nas/ klong na rol pa'i spyi bor rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje sku mdog sngo bsangs ras dkar gyi phya ru gsol zhing*/ chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can/ dbu skra bun ne ba rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag gi tshul du bsgom/ de'i spyi bor tshe dpag med mngon rtogs bzhin/ de'i thugs kar zla ba la hrī'i mtha' mar sngags 'phreng g.yas bskor du 'khor ba/ mdun du bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i sa gzhi nas/ dam la bzhag pa'i bar du byas/ tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros/ 'khor 'das kyi snod bcud thams cad la phog tshe bsod nams ye shes thams cad bsdus/ tshe dpag med kyi lhung bzed du thim pa 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsir gyur/ yar lud phyi nas mar zham gyis byung*/ bzhad pa rdo rje'i tshangs bug na/ mar skya ldur ldur babs/ sku lus gang*/ de'i gsang gnas nas babs/ slob ma rje btsun mar gsal ba dang lha mo lnga'i spyi gtsug na mar babs/ lus thams cad gang*/ slob ma'i tshe'i bar chad thams cad dag lus thams cad bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gtams shing brtan pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam/ lha mo lngas tshe'i 'brang rgyas mgo thog bzhag nas/ ā yu puṇ+ye dz+nyā na sid+dhi twa me bha hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ maṃ laṃ tsaṃ aṃ tāṃ/ zhes pas tshe ril byin/ tshe chang lud par mos/ dngos su slob dpon gyis so// de nas slob mas/ rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje la mi phyed pa'i dad pas gsol ba btab pas rje btsun gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros gtso mo la phog pas/ bka' ji ltar bsgos pa dran nas bzhengs te/ slob ma rje btsun mar gsal ba la/ bskor ba g.yas bskor du byed par mos te/ bla mas gtso mo'i 'brang rgyas slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag ste/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma// dpal 'bar bkra shis gzi brjid che// mi 'gyur yon tan kun rdzogs ma// srid bsrung tshe yi dngos grub stsol// zhes bka' bsgos pas jo mos tshe chang blud/

rang rtags kyi rdo rje lag par gtad/ bzhad pa rdo rje'i spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin// skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la// srid bsrung tshe yi dngos grub 'bul// oṃ maṃ maṅga la a yu dīr+gha añji dhā ra swā hā/ zhes smra bar bsam/ des 'jig rten pa yin na rigs brgyud 'phel ba dang*/ chos pa yin na slob brgyud dang*/ chos brgyud 'phel ba dang*/ tshe dpal bkra shis rgyas pa'i dngos grub phul zhing thob pa yin no// yang slob mas rje btsun= mthing gi zhal bzang ma la phog de'i 'brang rgyas= jo mo mthing gi zhal bzang ma// dpal= mi= snang gsal pra yi dngos grub stsol// zhes bka'= rang rtags kyi snang srid thams cad mthong ba'i me long lag tu gtad/ bzhad pa= ==snang gsal pra yi dngos grub 'bul// oṃ aṃ an+d+ri nī la mu kha bha dra añji dhā ra swā hā/ zhes smra zhing*/ snang gsal pra yi dngos grub phul ba thob pa yin no// yang slob/ mi g.yo glang bzang ma la phog jo mo mi g.yo glang bzang ma/ == rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub stsol// zhes bka'== rang rtags kyi zas ro brgya pa'i gzhong pa lag= oṃ aṃ a tsa la hā sa bha dra añji dhā ra swā hā/ zhes smra zhing*/ rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub phul ba thob par bsam mo// yang= cod pan mgrin bzang ma la phog= jo mo cod pan mgrin bzang ma/ ==bang mdzod nor gyi dngos grub stsol// zhes bka'= rang rtags kyi rin po che'i sgrom bu lag tu gtad/ = bang mdzod nor gyi dngos grub 'bul// oṃ tsaṃ mu ku ṭa ma dhū ra bha dra añji dhā ra swā hā/ zhes smra zhing*/ bang mdzod nor gyi dngos grub phul ba thob par bsam mo// yang= gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma la phog /jo mo gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma/ = rkang bzhi 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol// zhes bka'= rang rtags kyi dūr ba'i chun po lag tu gtad/ = rkang bzhi 'phel ba'i dngos grub 'bul/ oṃ tāṃ twad bha ba dza ga ta bha dra añji dhā ra swā hā/

zhes smra zhing*/ rkang bzhi 'phel ba'i dngos grub phul ba thob par bsam mo// gtor ma lnga kha tsak+ka li dang bcas pa mgo thog tu bzhag ste/ oṃ/ nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na// gangs dkar dgung du rtse mtho ba// mtho la gnyan no tshe ring ma// de la brten pa'i lha mo ni// gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma// 'khor du 'jig rten sman mo bzhi// gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma dang ni// mthing gi zhal bzang ma dang bcas// cod pan mgrin bzang ma dang ni// mi g.yo glang bzang 'khor dang bcas// sku la dar dkar ral gu gsol// sna tshogs dar gyi lhab lhub dang*// rin chen gser g.yu'i rgyan cha can// rdzu 'phrul chen po mnga' ba rnams// bstan ma bcu gnyis khyed kyi 'khor// so so'i g.yar dam ji bzhin du// slob bu 'di yi slad bzhin 'brongs// phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen sel// spyi dang khyad par dngos grub stsol// bcol ba'i las rnams thams cad bsgrubs// zhes pas bskul zhing gtad// oṃ ma ma ru ru zhes srog snying brjod de gnad la bor bas lha mo lnga pos spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig la gnas nas so so'i dngos grub stsol zhing 'phrin las bsgrub par khas blangs te rang rang gi phyogs su 'od kyi rnam par 'khod par bsam/ tshe chang blud/ gtor zan byin no// rjes tshogs la cho ga bzhin du rol pa'i mthar lhag ma btang*/ nongs pa 'chags/ nang dang gsang ba'i ḍā ki rang bzhin gyi gnas sam so so'i rten la gshegs gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal/ dkyil 'khor bsdus shis brjod rgyas par bya'o// de ltar rje btsun yab sras kyi phyag bzhes/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gi srol du ji ltar byung ba gzhan la ma bskyud par pad+ma dkar pos bsdebs pa dge legs su gyur cig //
